memory_candidates.content: When multiple SKILL.md/agent.md files implement the same producer/consumer metadata contract (e.g. completion_data -> state.json propagation), the working instances avoid drift by naming the exact field in their own local field enumeration and pointing at the shared schema doc by path -- not by duplicating the schema. When one instance is broken, check whether it silently references the schema abstractly (via a bare @-import with no local field name) rather than naming the field explicitly; that's the actual failure pattern, not missing documentation.

In a multi-agent session where several /implement dispatches run concurrently against the same repo, specs/state.json and specs/TODO.md legitimately carry other in-flight tasks' current index rows when committed, because they are shared, wholesale-regenerated files. The honest way to handle this (per git-staging-scope.md) is to stage them normally and append a commit-message line naming which other tasks' rows are carried (e.g. 'Also carries current index rows for tasks: 910, 911') rather than trying to surgically split the diff.
